This dataset is used to train a YOLOv2 model to detect and classify drug treated E. coli cells.

To test the trained model(s), we added two different test datasets:
	1) Images with only one treatment (as usually acquired in drug screening)
	2) Images including multiple treatments, created by randomly stitching small image patches together

For test dataset 2 we additionally provided the masks showing the particular treatment of each image quarter.


The classes used for training are the following:

Rifampicin, Oblique, Nalidixate, Mecillinam, CAM, Vesicle, Control, MP265
